page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Catchword "ad" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: paulò ante Nicænam Synodum, datâ quæ extat apud Socratem Histor. Eccles. L.1.C.iii. citat Epistolâ ad Hebræos, sub nomine Pauli Apostoli. Ἀλλὰ ὡς Ἀ̔ποστόλος [?] Χριστὸς χθὲς καὶ σήμερον ὁ αὐτὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας [?]. Sed sicut Apostolus, Iesus Christus heri, hodie idem ipse, qui locus est ad Hebr. C.xiii.v.8.

XI. Patres Concilij Niceni Oecumenici I. coacti anno Christiano cccxxv. dicuntur Hieronymo, Præfat.cxi. in Judith, Tomo iii. Scripturarum Canonicarum numerum computasse. Quod si verum est extrà omnem controversiam fuerit, Epistolam ad Hebræos Paulinis annumeratam. Quando ea tum communis Orientalium sententia, & ex Nicænis Patribus Athanasius, publicâ Constantis authoritate, Scripturæ synopsim texens, Paulinarum Catalogo Epist. ad Hebræos inseruit. Non recessurus sanè à Nicænorum mente atque decreto. Quando etiam horum fuit tueri eandem ac vindicare adversus Arrianorum insultus, Paulo Epistolam derogantium. Ita etiam Baronius ad

page.notes: The running head is partly worn; read as "De authore Epistolæ". The Greek line in the first paragraph is heavily blurred and is only approximate; the marked words are doubtful. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. A stray mark at the lower left ("c...") is not printed text and is left out. Several words in the body are smudged, notably "Athanasius", "Constantis", and the word after "Quando etiam"; these are read as printed but are uncertain.
